data.name: HeroTitle
data.value: Keep track of your plants and the cuttings you grow from them

data.name: HeroLead
data.value: Each one gets a history of photos and notes: where it came from, what it's rooting in, and how long it took.

data.name: HeroFree
data.value: It's free, with no ads or subscription, and works offline. Everything is kept on your device, and you don't need an account.

data.name: Loading
data.comment: Under the progress bar while the app downloads.

data.name: LoadingNote
data.value: The first visit downloads all of it, so it works offline later. After that it opens straight away.

data.comment: Describes a screenshot.

data.name: ShotPlantAlt

data.comment: Describes a screenshot.

data.name: StoryText
data.value: A cutting, or anything else you grow into a new plant, gets a page of its own, linked to the plant it came from. Stikling calls them propagations. Here is one pothos cutting, from the first snip to a plant of its own.

data.name: Step1Title
data.comment: First step in the life of a cutting.

data.name: Step1Text
data.value: Snipped from the pothos on the shelf and put in a jar of water. The plant's page now lists it too.

data.name: Step2Text
data.value: The first roots. One tap moves it on and notes the day, and a photo goes on its history.

data.name: Step3Text
data.value: Into soil and onto your plant list as a plant of its own, which still knows the plant it came from.

data.name: Step4Text
data.value: Take cuttings from it in turn, or give one to a friend and note who got it. The family line carries on.

data.name: KeepsText
data.value: All of it is optional. A plant with just a name is fine.

data.name: KeepsTodayText
data.value: What needs a look: cuttings you haven't checked on for a while, treatments that are due, and anything you flagged.

data.name: KeepsCareText
data.value: Watering, feeding and repotting, each logged in a tap, along with the pots, soil mixes and fertilisers you use.

data.name: KeepsPestsText
data.value: Spider mites on a few plants, or yellow leaves on one: a pest case keeps the treatments and when the next is due, and a problem keeps what you tried and whether it helped.

data.name: KeepsRootsText
data.value: Start cuttings in water, LECA, perlite and moss side by side, and see which rooted and how fast.

data.name: KeepsPhotosText
data.value: Pick photos from your gallery and each lands on the day it was taken, so a history goes back to when you got the plant.

data.name: KeepsDevicesText
data.value: Sign in to keep the same plants on every device, or save everything to a backup file. You don't need either.

data.name: FreeA
data.value: Yes. There are no ads, no subscription and nothing to unlock. It's a hobby project, and it stays free.

data.name: AccountA
data.value: No. Everything works without one. Signing in only keeps your plants the same on every device you use.

data.name: OfflineA
data.value: Yes. After the first visit everything is kept on your device, photos included, so it opens and works offline.
